title_zh: Anthropic 更新使用政策：禁止對 Claude 持續無故殘忍對待（11 月 12 日生效）
title_en: Anthropic 2026 Usage Policy update: bans sustained needless cruelty toward Claude, effective 12 Nov
summary_zh: Anthropic 於 2026 年 10 月 8 日發佈新版使用政策，11 月 12 日生效。新增禁止「持續且無故的虐待或殘忍行為」針對其模型，但只針對極端、重複、無可辨目的的情況；一般挫折、批評、黑暗創作主題與模型測試研究不受影響。主要執行方式仍是 Claude 終止該段對話。同次更新亦釐清高風險健康與金融用途、自主實體操作及欺騙性宣傳等條款。
summary_en: Anthropic published a new Usage Policy on 8 October 2026, effective 12 November. It adds a ban on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behaviour toward its models, limited to extreme cases of repeated cruelty with no discernible purpose; ordinary frustration, pushback, dark creative themes and model testing or research are excluded. Claude's ability to end such conversations remains the main enforcement mechanism. The update also clarifies high-risk health and finance use, autonomous physical actions and deceptive activity.
evidence_note: 公司官方政策公告（一手來源）
brief_zh: 這是政策條文的更新，主要是澄清既有規則
一般使用者的情緒性批評不受影響，範圍僅限極端重複的殘忍對待
對心理服務者的意義：高風險健康用途的要求有所清楚列明
supervision_questions: 當來訪者用粗暴語言對待 AI 時，我們會如何理解這種互動？

related.title_zh: 韓國發佈心理健康 AI 使用指引：勿把聊天機器人回應當醫療診斷
related.title_en: South Korea issues mental health AI guidelines: do not treat chatbot answers as medical diagnoses
related.summary_zh: 韓國保健福祉部與韓國神經精神醫學會於 2026 年 10 月 8 日發佈心理健康 AI 使用指引，一般使用者 21 條，兒童青少年與監護人各 7 條。調查發現自評心理健康差的人最容易把 AI 回應當成醫療判斷（33.9%），向 AI 傾訴自殺衝動者近半數事後沒有求助。指引把「取得資訊或安慰」和「把診斷治療交給機器」劃出界線。
related.summary_en: The Korean Ministry of Health and Welfare and the Korean Neuropsychiatric Association released mental-health AI guidelines on 8 October 2026: 21 recommendations for general users plus 7 each for children/adolescents and guardians. Among respondents with poor self-rated mental health, 33.9% had treated AI responses as medical judgement; among 115 who disclosed depression, self-harm or suicidal urges to AI, 49.6% took no further action. The guidance allows talking to AI but asks that diagnosis, treatment and major life decisions go back to professionals.

related.title_zh: ACA 支持《Doctors Not AI Act》：保險 AI 不得取代臨床判斷
related.title_en: ACA backs Doctors Not AI Act to curb AI-driven insurance coverage denials
related.summary_zh: 美國諮商學會（ACA）宣布與另外 44 個心理健康與醫療組織共同支持兩黨法案《Doctors Not AI Act》（H.R. 10210）。該法案針對保險公司以 AI、演算法自動審查理賠、決定醫療必要性的做法設下防線：凡需臨床判斷的拒保決定，必須由具適當專長的持牌醫療人員做出，且須提高透明度並考量個人情況。
related.summary_en: On 2 Oct 2026 the American Counseling Association joined 44 other mental-health and medical organizations backing the bipartisan Doctors Not AI Act (H.R. 10210): insurers could not use AI alone to deny coverage, medical-necessity denials would need a licensed professional with appropriate expertise, with more transparency and individual circumstances considered.

related.title_zh: 加州州長否決 SB 903：AI 心理治療限制法案未能成法
related.title_en: Newsom vetoes California SB 903 on AI in therapy
related.summary_zh: 加州州長 Newsom 否決了 SB 903。該法案原本要禁止 AI 演算法提供或宣傳心理治療服務，持照專業人員只能把 AI 用於行政或輔助支援，用 AI 錄製治療會談前須清楚揭露並取得同意，也不准 AI 獨立與個案互動或作治療決定。法案在參議院全票通過、眾議院以 71 比 4 通過；州長的否決理由認為對病人與臨床人員的保護「過了頭」，提案人 Padilla 則強烈批評。
related.summary_en: California Governor Gavin Newsom vetoed SB 903, which would have barred AI from providing or advertising therapy, limited licensed clinicians to administrative or supplementary AI use, required disclosure and consent before AI recording of sessions, and banned AI from independently interacting with clients or making therapeutic decisions. The bill had passed the Senate unanimously and the Assembly 71-4; the veto message said its protections went too far, drawing sharp criticism from author Sen. Steve Padilla.
